description: An integer dividend and a positive constant modulus bound the residue to [0, modulus-1], so (i % k) + 1 is a proven index into an array whose length floor is at least k: the element read publishes presence and reads T rather than T?. The bound is the whole proof, so it withdraws when the modulus exceeds the floor, when an offset moves the residue window past the floor, when the modulus is negative, or when the dividend can be a float.

facts.name: the residue-bounded read is proven present

facts.name: a modulus above the floor proves nothing

facts.name: an offset past the floor proves nothing
